scope: LOCAL_ONLY bounded preflight resource estimate for image/video candidate generation

profile_policy_authority.details: Generation preflight returns a bounded per-take estimate sourced only from explicit Published Profile resource_policy fields. Duration, VRAM and disk values remain null/unknown when the policy does not declare them; no model-name, Runtime or static default is used.

submission_gate.details: GenerationWorkbench shows duration, VRAM, disk and CPU estimates before confirmation, keeps unknown fields visibly undeclared, and still requires the existing server preflight plan before the Variant/Job confirmation button can run.

local_model_boundary.details: The estimate contains no model bytes or paths and does not upload/copy user-selected local model references; execution remains bound to the local Published Profile and loopback Runtime contract.

automated_tests: apps/web/src/features/generation/GenerationWorkbench.test.tsx::persists intent and prompt, then requires a second confirmation for Variant plus Job

required: real user-selected Published Profile with declared resource policy
real Runtime run comparing declared estimate with observed telemetry

notes: This is implementation and negative-path evidence only; FR-IMG-002 remains PARTIAL until real local Runtime UAT is recorded.
